name: Rows
description: Rows is a powerful online spreadsheet tool designed to enhance productivity and collaboration. It offers advanced features for data analysis, automation, and integration with various apps and services.

events.d: Add a new row to the selected table using the values you provide.
Create a new table with the given name on the chosen page of your spreadsheet.
Deletes the selected table from the chosen spreadsheet.
Renames a table in the chosen spreadsheet to the new name you provide.
Adds a new page (tab) to the selected spreadsheet using the name you provide.
Remove a page (tab) from the chosen spreadsheet so it no longer appears.
Rename the selected spreadsheet to the name you enter.
Retrieve the cells from a selected range in a spreadsheet table for use in your workflow.
